paragraphs.text: After wind and rain, distinguish broken palings from a moving post or a gate that now drags. Note which bays move and whether the ground beside a post stays wet. Visible movement needs assessment of the supports and connections; replacing the obvious broken board may leave the main fault unresolved.

Our Mile End fence-section repair shows completed repair work; our Modbury fence assessment record is assessment-only, with no completed repair recorded. Tell us about broken palings, loose rails or moving posts so we can assess the supports as well as the visible damage.

Compare local board or rail repair with post work and wider replacement as separate options. Timber condition, fixings, boundary permission and access affect the quote. A leaning retaining wall, washout or pool-barrier fault needs a separate specialist scope; keep away from unstable sections.

We assess gate hinges, supports and latch contact together. See our North Adelaide timber-gate repair for an example. Tell us whether your gate drags throughout its swing or only near closing. Boundary permission and access need agreement before work; pool barriers and security systems need a separate specialist scope.

A loose board, moving post and gate that drags are different maintenance requests. MEL ONE assesses the affected fence or gate, its supports and visible fittings before proposing the repair. Describe the material, approximate affected length and whether the concern is movement, damaged timber, a hinge connection or closing alignment.

The condition of surrounding components matters when deciding whether a local repair is appropriate. Replacing one board may not address a failing support. Tell us if the gate is difficult to open or if loose sections could fall; avoid leaning on unstable fencing or testing it repeatedly.

For a timber fence, distinguish damaged palings from loose rails or posts. For a timber garden gate, describe dragging, hinge movement and latch contact. Connected supports are assessed before a local repair is proposed; replacing the visible damaged piece alone may not address the cause.

The Mile End fence and North Adelaide timber-gate records show repair work on different components. The Modbury fence record is assessment-only: it documents condition and planning, not completed repair. Ask the quote to identify boards, supports, hardware, finishing and waste handling where relevant.

Affected boards, rails, posts, hinges and latches are assessed as connected parts. Material, access, waste handling and shared-boundary permissions can affect the plan. Ask which components will be repaired or replaced and whether finishing is included. Automatic gates and pool barriers require separate specialist arrangements.

MEL ONE assesses the hinges, supporting post, latch and clearances to identify a suitable repair. The cause may be alignment or a damaged support; trimming the base is not assumed. The scope, parts and quote are agreed after assessment.

Can one damaged fence section be repaired?

A local repair may be possible, depending on the supports and neighbouring components. Assessment determines whether a limited repair addresses the problem or a wider scope needs discussion.

What should I report about a dragging gate?

Describe where it touches, how it latches and any visible movement at the hinges or posts. Avoid forcing the gate or placing weight on a loose connection.

Is the Modbury fence example a completed repair?

No. It is an assessment record showing the reported condition and repair planning. It must not be read as evidence of completed repair work.

Can a leaning fence be repaired without replacing it all?

That depends on the posts, rails, connections and extent of deterioration. The Modbury record documents assessment only. MEL ONE checks the affected section and explains whether a local repair, wider replacement or specialist assessment is appropriate.

Does a leaning fence after rain need repair or replacement?

The posts, rails, connections and extent of deterioration determine the options, not the visible lean alone. Tell us which sections move, any broken boards and nearby persistent wet ground. Local timber repair and wider replacement need separate assessment. A retaining wall or unstable support needs suitable specialist attention; do not push the fence to test it.

What should a timber fence and gate repair quote separate?

Identify the affected palings, rails or posts and any gate hinge, latch or closing problem separately. The condition of adjoining supports determines whether a local repair is suitable. Ask which parts, preparation, finishing and removed material are included, and clarify shared-boundary access or approval. The quote should describe the agreed section rather than imply the entire fence is being replaced.

paragraphs.text: 风雨后，请区分栅板破损、立柱松动和门扇拖地，并说明哪几段晃动、立柱旁的地面是否持续潮湿。出现明显位移时，需要评估支撑和连接件；只更换最显眼的破板，可能仍未处理主要故障。
我们的 Mile End 围栏局部维修 展示了已完成的维修；我们的 Modbury 围栏评估记录 仅作评估，没有记录已完成维修。请说明破损围栏板、松动横档或晃动立柱，以便我们一并评估支撑和可见损伤。
请把局部栅板或横档维修、立柱施工和较大范围更换作为不同方案比较。木材状态、连接件、边界施工许可和通道条件都会影响报价。倾斜的挡土墙、地面冲刷或泳池围栏故障需要另行专门评估，请远离不稳定的围栏段。
我们会一并评估院门合页、支撑和门闩接触情况。可参考我们的 North Adelaide 木质院门维修 。请说明院门是在整个开合过程中拖地，还是接近关闭时才卡住。施工前须商定边界许可和进出条件；泳池屏障及安防系统需要单独的专业范围。
木板松动、立柱晃动和院门拖地属于不同的维护需求。MEL ONE 会评估受影响的围栏或院门、支撑结构和可见配件，再提出维修方案。请描述材料、受影响的大致长度，以及问题涉及晃动、木材损坏、铰链连接还是关闭时的对齐。
判断是否适合局部维修时，周边部件状态也很重要。更换一块木板可能无法解决支撑失效。请告知院门是否难以打开，或松动部分是否可能掉落；不要靠在不稳的围栏上，也不要反复测试。
木围栏应区分竖板损坏与横梁或立柱松动。木质花园门请描述拖擦、铰链晃动和门闩接触情况。提出局部修法前要评估相连支承；只更换可见损坏部件，未必能解决原因。
Mile End 围栏和 North Adelaide 木院门记录展示了不同部件的维修。Modbury 围栏记录仅为评估：记录状况和计划，不是已完成的维修。请报价视情况明确木板、支撑、五金、表面收尾和废料处理。
受影响的木板、横档、立柱、铰链和门闩会作为相互连接的部件进行评估。材料、通行条件、废料处理及共用边界许可，均可能影响方案。请确认哪些部件会维修或更换，以及是否包含表面收尾。自动门和泳池围栏需另行安排专业服务。

faq:
可以维修拖地的庭院门吗？

MEL ONE 会评估铰链、支撑立柱、门闩和间隙，以确定合适维修。原因可能是对齐或支撑损坏，并不默认需要修切门底。范围、配件和报价在评估后商定。

可以只修损坏的一段围栏吗？

能否局部维修取决于支承和相邻部件。评估将确定有限范围修复能否解决问题，或是否需讨论更大范围工作。

庭院门拖地时应报告哪些情况？

请描述接触位置、门闩扣合情况，以及铰链或立柱处的可见移动。避免强推院门或在松动连接处施加重量。

Modbury 围栏案例是已完成的维修吗？

不是。这是评估记录，展示反映的状况和维修计划，不能解读为已完成维修的证据。

倾斜围栏可以修复而不全部更换吗？

这取决于立柱、横梁、连接和老化程度。Modbury 记录仅展示评估。MEL ONE 会检查受影响段，说明适合局部维修、较大范围更换，还是专业评估。

雨后围栏倾斜，应维修还是更换？

应根据立柱、横档、连接件和劣化范围判断，不能只看倾斜外观。请说明哪几段晃动、是否有破板，以及附近地面是否持续潮湿。局部木作维修和较大范围更换需要分别评估。挡土墙或不稳定支撑需要适当的专门处理，请勿推动围栏测试。

木围栏及侧门维修报价应分别列明哪些项目？

请分别指出受影响的围栏板、横梁或立柱，以及门铰链、门闩或闭合问题。相邻支撑的状况决定局部维修是否适合。询问报价包含哪些零件、准备工作、表面处理及拆下材料的处理，并确认共用边界的进出条件或批准安排。报价应描述商定维修的区段，不能直接理解为更换整道围栏。
